A LIFE ROOTED IN PRAYER
Weekly Devotional

Key Scripture: Colossians 4:2

Prayer is not only what we do in a moment of need. It is the steady rhythm of a life that depends on God. A rooted life returns to His presence in gratitude, uncertainty, joy and sorrow.

This Week
- Begin each morning with five quiet minutes before God.
- Write one Scripture to carry through the day.
- Pray by name for one person in your family and one person in Katoloni.
- End the day by thanking God for one sign of His faithfulness.

Prayer
Father, teach me to remain close to You. Make my life attentive, thankful and faithful in prayer. Amen.
